descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S05 Existing spec: Nursing Home Medications panel from the pre-round and from the visit, and the note's held-medication facts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 Nursing Home has its own Medications panel, filled from the pre-round (PR #56). (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 AC 3)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U10 Same drug in two forms → two rows; brand/generic → one row. (UAT TC-19 ER 7; TFA-92597 R8; TFA-94229 R6)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)
  • T4 A restarted or resumed medication no longer shows stale 'held' language, on the tracker or in the note. (TFA-94655 AC 3)
  • U2 The generated note's plan and medication section reflect the tracker: held and stopped drugs are surfaced from the tracker rows, not from older notes or a regex over them. (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 AC 4; TFA-94655 AC 1)
  • T5 A long-standing Nursing Home hold (e.g. metformin) still displays correctly months later. (TFA-94655 AC 4)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Nursing Home resident; pre-round parse and visit extraction answered at the socket

When Pre-round Save Note with parsed medications; with a held drug the model calls active; with a new drug sharing a word with a row on file; Generate Note & Finish with a hold dictated only at the visit, and with a restart dictated only at the visit; …

Then Parsed medications reach the Nursing Home panel; the held drug stays Held with its date; the new drug gets its own row; a visit hold holds the row with today's date and the dictated reason; a visit restart ends the hold (active, resumed, today); …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions on the saved rows and the 'Held · <date>' tag after reload. Code layer only. The held-medication test covers TFA-94655 AC 1 and the input side of AC 4 (a six-month-old Nursing Home hold still reaches the note); what the note says is S25

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-19 Medication Tracker · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-19/S05

Existing spec: Nursing Home Medications panel from the pre-round and from the visit, and the note's held-medication facts

Tickets: TFA-92597 Medication Tracker (ready for qa); TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress); TFA-94655 Held Medications in Generated Notes Read from Tracker, Not Old-Note Regex (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-19.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts [chromium] — the parsed medications reach the Nursing Home panel — expected
  • medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts [chromium] — a held drug the dictation does not restart stays Held (rule 4) — expected
  • medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts [chromium] — a new drug never lands on another drug's row through a shared word — expected
  • medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts [chromium] — the held-medication facts are the tracker rows, never a previous visit's note — expected
  • medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts [chromium] — a hold dictated only at the visit holds the row — expected
  • medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts [chromium] — a restart dictated only at the visit ends the hold — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium spec e2e/medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts): fresh accounts and seeded rows through the local admin key, model answers at the socket; dev has no admin key and no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
